mapper_a_opus.reason: A one-shot read sampled the layout mid-transition; the content had not finished settling within the window the assertion read it.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Single read sampled mid-update; fixed with a retrying poll.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The response wait used a URL pattern that never matched the actual PUT request (an unmatched network intercept), with shared-persona ordering making it an update rather than a create.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Wait matched the wrong URL pattern, so the API wait never fires; no code fits a bad waitForResponse glob well.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Parallel tests' uploads mutate the shared paginated list and evict the row, which is cross-test shared state leaking into this test.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Parallel uploads from other tests evict the row from page 1, leaked shared state.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The helper assumes the search box is present and only navigates on one branch, so the conditionally absent element was driven unconditionally.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Page object helper navigated only on one branch, leaving the page on about:blank.

mapper_a_opus.reason: A non-retrying probe on a virtualised list threw inside the poll, defeating the retry budget; this is a timing/wait defect, though not-yet-rendered rows also fit F14.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Non-retrying isVisible probe in a virtualised list aborted a retrying poll.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The assertion demanded one specific ordering where two outcomes are equally correct; the fix relaxes it to a set comparison.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Assertion pinned one side of a coin flip tie; relaxed to set comparison.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Two parallel fetches resolve in nondeterministic order and the later basic fetch clobbers state, a parallel race on async order.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Parallel basic/advanced fetches resolved in an order the code assumed.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Options were clicked before the dropdown finished its render animation.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Clicked dropdown options before the animated dropdown finished rendering.

mapper_a_opus.reason: An instant visibility check missed an asynchronously rendering modal, and the fallback branch then acted on the wrong state.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Modal renders asynchronously and visibility was checked instantly.

mapper_a_opus.reason: A closing dropdown overlay lingered during its animation and intercepted the next click.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Lingering overlay during close animation intercepted the next click.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The failure stems from an uncaught:exception suppression handler that was mis-scoped by stack and by timing, letting expected errors land in an after-all hook; F13 is the nearest code although nothing was hidden.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Blanket-ish uncaught:exception handler missed the errors, which then fired in a hook window.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The tour's fixed 900 ms window expired before the lazily loaded target element rendered.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Lazy-loaded chunk not ready within the tour's fixed wait; a timing race with no better code.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The test depended on a network response that never occurred because a cache in the same worker served the data, so waitForResponse hung.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: React Query cache served result with no network request so waitForResponse hung.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The test assumed an HTTP 200 meant the asynchronous backend processing had finished, so the UI was asserted before the write landed.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Backend processes the move asynchronously; UI asserted before it landed.

mapper_a_opus.reason: A late auto-scroll event closed the just-opened popover, removing a transient element before it could be used.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Scroll event landing after listbox opens closes it; a timing/animation race.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Wall-clock time could cross a minute boundary between creation and assertion, a timing nondeterminism that no code captures precisely.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Minute-tick timestamp race between creation and assertion; time-dependent, not a fit for any code well.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Non-exact accessible-name matching resolved to two headings and caused a strict-mode violation.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Non-exact accessible name matched two headings, a strict-mode violation.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The test waited on only one intercept and read rows before the rest of the initial data fetch completed, an intercept/wait ordering gap.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Asserted rows before the full initial data fetch completed.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Parallel workers race on a singleton optimistic-lock resource, and synchronized retries keep colliding.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Parallel workers collide on a shared singleton resource.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The DELETE response arrived before React re-rendered, so a one-shot count read stale DOM.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Asserted right after API response before React re-render.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Typing happened during the modal's open animation while the focus trap was stealing focus, so keystrokes were lost.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Typed during animated modal; focus trap stole keystrokes.

mapper_a_opus.reason: A substring text locator matched a second element and caused a strict-mode violation.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: getByText substring match resolved to two elements, strict-mode violation.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The click 'succeeded' at a point outside the shape and left the wrong state, and no check confirmed the selection took effect; the fix adds that check.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Click target point was outside the shape so the selection cleared; closest is a bad target locator.

mapper_a_opus.reason: A debounced fetch followed by an async re-render detached the element while it was being clicked.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Debounce and async re-render detached the element before the click.

mapper_a_opus.reason: The attribute was read once, without retrying, before the upload response had populated it.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Non-retrying single attribute read before the upload response set it.

mapper_a_opus.reason: Parallel workers share a well-known discovery port, so their dashboards leak into each other's state.

mapper_b_sonnet.reason: Parallel workers' dashboards discover each other through a shared port.
